The edge of the leather sheath lacks fine fibrous detail and appears slightly 'waxy' or overly smooth, blending softly into the background rather than having a crisp cut edge.

selected_experts.reason: To confirm the specific type of knife and distinguish it from similar classes like chef's knife or butcher knife.
To verify the physical connection between the handle and blade (tang) and ensure no floating artifacts or boundary bleeding.
To assess the realism of the lighting reflections on the steel and the texture of the leather sheath.

focus_areas: Edge sharpness of the leather sheath
custom_prompts_for_reflector: Pay close attention to the transition between the metal blade and the wooden handle. AI often fails to render the 'tang' correctly, resulting in a handle that looks glued on rather than structurally integrated. Also, scrutinize the background markings; if they are nonsensical shapes mimicking text, this is a strong indicator of generation artifacts.
